snippet.title: NEW Game Mode to Test Your Pathogen! - Pathogenic Dev Log #4
snippet.description:
This update adds a collection of new multi-hit weapons and a whole new game mode to Pathogenic!

🦠 Wishlist the game and play the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3808690/Pathogenic/

🗒️Update Patch Notes: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3808690/view/521987045620452216?l=english

In Pathogenic, you ARE the disease. Become the infection in a 2D roguelike twin-stick shooter - a lone parasite, fighting a biological war. Collect organelles to evolve your cell in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

#gaming #indiegame #gamedev #roguelike #pcgaming
